en-US.subject: BitFun sign-in code
en-US.preview: Your BitFun sign-in code expires in 10 minutes.
en-US.heading: Sign in to BitFun
en-US.intro: Enter the code below on the sign-in page to continue your work and creation.
en-US.security: Keep this code private. If you did not request it, you can safely ignore this email.
en-US.footer: Open source, more freedom to create
en-US.plain:
Your BitFun verification code is: {{code}}

It expires in 10 minutes and can only be used once. Do not share this code.
If you did not request it, ignore this email.
